# PROPOSALS — the improvement backlog

*Where the system's own ideas for improving itself live. Generated by the weekly workshop, decided
by Vince.*

---

## How this works

**Every proposal must name the v1 blocker it removes.** v1 is the finished Yu-Gi-Oh! film plus the
architecture that finished it (`GOALS.md`). A proposal that cannot name what it unblocks is **parked**,
not built — however clever it is. This is the sharpest anti-drift tool in the system.

### The three brakes

An agent asked to improve things will always find things to improve. Without limits this backlog
becomes the bloat it exists to prevent.

| Brake | Rule |
|---|---|
| **WIP limit** | Max **7** open at once. A new idea must **displace a worse one**, not just be appended. Forces ranking. |
| **Expiry** | Open **30 days** with no decision → the workshop expires it. If it mattered, it comes back. |
| **The v1 test** | No named v1 blocker → `parked`. Reconsidered when v1 ships. |

### Autonomy tiers (`DECISIONS.md` D-013)

| Tier | Meaning | Agent may |
|---|---|---|
| **GREEN** | Mechanical, reversible, no product judgment — doc/index sync, dead refs, stale counts, tests for existing code, Miro refresh, gitignore hygiene | **Execute, commit, report after.** No approval needed. |
| **AMBER** | Changes how the system behaves — new skill, changed skill contract, merging or retiring a component, restructuring, new dependency | **Propose only.** Waits for Vince's ✅. |
| **RED** | `GOALS.md` · the gate protocol · deleting anything · product strategy · charged register · `profile/TASTE.md` | **Never autonomous. Ever.** Proposal only, permanently. |

### Status values

`open` (awaiting decision) · `accepted` (✅, not built) · `done` · `rejected` · `parked` (no v1 link
yet) · `expired`

**Rejected and expired rows are never deleted** — same principle as the ideation boneyard. A rejected
idea that keeps resurfacing is information.

## Writing a good proposal

- **One change per row.** If it needs "and", it is two proposals.
- **Name the blocker concretely.** "Improves quality" is not a blocker. "Style composition stage is
  undocumented, so it breaks when a fresh session runs it" is.
- **Say what you would do, not what is wrong.** Findings belong in the checkpoint; proposals are
  actions.
- **Prefer deletion and merging over addition.** The best proposal removes something. A backlog that
  only ever grows the system has misunderstood the job.
